title: Clinical Resources | Lyme Disease | CDC
content: Clinical Resources Apr. 14, 2026 At a glance CDC is working to compile the most up to date guidance and information for front-line healthcare professionals to consult when treating and preventing Lyme Disease in patients. Check out the resources below for more information. Tools for the clinic Caring for patients after a tick bite Caring for patients after a tick bite Download Download Tickborne Diseases of the United States Reference manual of tickborne diseases for healthcare professionals The many forms of Lyme disease rashes The many forms of Lyme disease rashes (Erythema Migrans) Download Download National Association of Pediatric Nurse Practitioners (NAPNAP) Pocket Guide Download Download More NAPNAP Resources Improving Care for Patients with Prolonged Symptoms and Concerns about Lyme Disease: A Clinician Toolkit Lyme disease prophylaxis after tick bite Video: Lyme Disease Prophylaxis After Tick Bite Lyme disease prophylaxis after tick bite Lyme disease prophylaxis after tick bite poster Download Download Lyme disease prophylaxis after tick bite Printable poster for Lyme disease prophylaxis after tick bite algorithm Download Download Note: In certain circumstances , a single dose of doxycycline after a tick bite in an area where Lyme disease is common may lower risk of Lyme disease. Ask your healthcare provider if antibiotics after a tick bite are appropriate for you. Lyme disease serologic testing and pretest probability A patient’s pretest probability for Lyme disease helps inform whether they should be tested for Lyme disease. Video: Lyme Disease Serologic Testing Video: Pretest Probability of Lyme Disease Pretest probability of Lyme disease Clinical poster about Lyme disease pretest probability and serologic testing Download Download Pretest Probability of Lyme Disease Printable clinical poster about Lyme disease pretest probability and serologic testing Download Download Evaluation of pediatric knee monoarthritis in areas where Lyme disease occurs Pediatric knee monoarthritis where Lyme disease occurs Poster regarding evaluation of pediatric knee monoarthritis where Lyme disease occurs Download Download Pediatric knee monoarthritis where Lyme disease occurs Printable poster for evaluation of pediatric knee monoarthritis where Lyme disease occurs Download Download Note: This tool is intended to support healthcare providers. Providers should use clinical judgement, taking into account the patient's history, diagnostic testing, and prior treatment when making clinical decisions for their patients. Special thanks to Pedi Lyme Net and Dr. Lise Nigrovic for their research and input on the flow chart. APHL guidance and interpretation of Lyme disease serologic test results These tools describe the proper interpretation of serologic testing for B. burgdorferi and identify best practices for reporting results to clinicians, public health agencies, and patients.
